title: Galaxy hero
description: A centred statement on black: a huge, tightly tracked two-line headline (four lines on phones) with small square art tiles set inline between the words and one word in a signal colour, an 18px lead below, and two outlined pill buttons ringed in orange and blue. A full-bleed backdrop slot sits behind it all.
notes: the backdrop slot is meant for an animated starfield or canvas; empty, it shows a faint glow wash low in the hero
give phones their own line breaks with mobileLines; desktop uses lines
reads --galaxy-stretch to narrow the headline when the galaxy theme is on
